title: Contract compatibility
description: OpenAPI 3.1.1 and SDK engineering: checked-in contract, executable assertion, red starter, instructor fix and compatibility/security limitations.
objectives: Removing an operation or formerly successful response is a breaking change to generated clients; mark newly required request bodies as incompatible.

rubric: I understand the OpenAPI contract behind contract compatibility.
